name: kenspc
description: Structured software development workflows for Claude Code, aligned with Claude 5 generation guidance (last reviewed 2026-09-29): effort follows the session, with three overrides (high for unattended implementation and fixing, xhigh for multi-round planning). Skills cover project initialization (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and the project documents), brief generation, prototyping, plan generation, task decomposition, bug diagnosis, automated batch implementation, multi-angle parallel review, project guide generation, and unattended batch runs to a release preparation, each role's worker at the model and effort the spec declares for it or at the main session's own, and its rails — no recursive rm, no write outside the repository, the workspace, and scratch — carried to every subagent it dispatches, in text and by a PreToolUse hook; eleven reusable subagents do the review, fix, verification, and implementation work. The v3 architecture follows six design rules: workflow SOP stays, business rules framed as why-not-command, DONE-criteria over step-by-step flow, no anti-rationalization scaffolding, plain language over MUST/NEVER/CRITICAL/ULTRATHINK, and review rubrics with named failure modes over generic checklists.
